channel.title: Calenbar
channel.description: Updates for Calenbar, the menu bar calendar.

item.title: Calenbar 0.5.0
item.description: **A shortcut to join, an alert that doesn't take over, and days off on the calendar.** - **⌃⌘J joins the next meeting from any app.** Change or remove the shortcut in Settings › General. The same action is in the menu bar item's right-click menu and the panel's ••• menu. - **The alert is a small card now.** It appears in a corner of the screen when a meeting starts, over every desktop and full-screen app, with a live countdown, the room, who's coming, Join and Snooze (1, 5 or 10 minutes, or until it starts). Overlapping meetings stack their cards. Full screen is still there as a choice. Both styles leave on their own when the meeting ends. - **Try before you decide.** Settings › Notifications has “Send Test Notification” and “Show Test Alert”. - **Days off on the calendar.** Time off (Out of office, PTO, vacation and their equivalents in nine languages) and holiday calendars tint their days in the month view and get an icon in the list. - **How busy is that day.** One, two or three dots under each day, and optional week numbers. - **Calendars, by account.** Settings › Calendars groups them by account; unchecking List drops a calendar from Calenbar in one click, and the ••• button hides it, shows it everywhere or marks it as a holidays calendar. - **Mirrored events show once.** A personal event copied into a work calendar is one row, even when the copy says just “Busy” or carries a tag; the card names the other calendar. - **Sharing your screen?** Hide event titles and the menu bar says “Meeting • in 12m” until you turn it back on. - **New meeting, now.** Start a Google Meet, Zoom or Microsoft Teams call from the panel's ••• menu. - **Updates you can see.** When one is waiting, the menu bar icon gets a dot and both menus offer “Update to…” or “Restart to Update”. - **No Accessibility permission.** On displays without a notch, the title width is Automatic (it learns how much room your apps leave) or Short, Medium or Long. - Up to five world clocks, with no duplicates. Settings › Notifications says when macOS has notifications turned off for Calenbar. Install with Homebrew: `brew install --cask hercase/calenbar/calenbar --no-quarantine`.

item.title: Calenbar 0.4.1
item.description: The full-screen alert is now off by default and can target a chosen screen; no alert for meetings you already joined; the panel and the Calendars tab say when the Mac has no calendar account; the menu bar item keeps its place.

item.title: Calenbar 0.4.0
item.description: In-app updates, a redesigned event card, a clearer Settings window and a landing page for new users.
